handoff.purpose: Process dispatch results per round, build batch of turns, update outcomes, construct participant records, and return CouncilRecord.

symbols.name: (loop body)
symbols.note: Iterates rounds: dispatches jobs, builds batch of turns, appends round to store, updates outcomes and claims, checks for spoke_any, breaks if no voice.

symbols.name: participant_records
symbols.note: Tuple of ParticipantRecord constructed from seated and outcomes.

symbols.name: append_roster
symbols.note: Appends roster with close phase to store.

symbols.name: verify_chain
symbols.note: Verifies chain integrity, returns intact and failures.

observations.what: The comment 'A blown wall clock is NOT handled here: the next iteration's top-of-round check records a budget_exhausted turn per participant first. Breaking early would shorten the council silently.' explains that budget exhaustion is handled at the start of the next round, not here.
When spoke_any is False, the loop breaks with ended = 'no_voice'.
participant_records includes 'operator_trusted' based on vendor in trusted.
append_roster is called with phase='close' and a list of dicts from participant_records.

CouncilRecord includes summary fields like requested, responded, seated_n, unavailable, distinct_classes, duplicate_classes, degraded, anomalies, floor_rule, ended, store_path, chain_head, chain_intact, chain_failures, tokens_charged.
tokens_charged is included in the return but its source is not defined in this chunk.
